component.name: CacheTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fillCache" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.cache = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") ' Registered on the render thread against the field that HOLDS the ContentNode — not ' against the ContentNode itself. Mutating the held node must notify this observer. m.top.observeField("cache", m.port) end sub
sub fillCache() rows = 0 for i = 0 to 2 row = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") row.title = "row" + i.toStr() fields = {} fields[i.toStr()] = row ' Rendezvous call: applies on the render thread, where the real ContentNode lives. m.top.cache.addFields(fields) ' Drain whatever the mutation notified us about. for attempt = 0 to 20 msg = wait(100, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" and msg.getField() = "cache" rows = rows + 1 print "TASK SAW CACHE CHANGE "; rows.toStr() exit for end if end for end for m.top.rowsSeen = rows end sub
